subject.title: feat(feishu): route exact DMs with fail-closed enforcement

question: Should exact provider conversation matching be adopted as a generic core `bindings` API, or should Feishu own the selector and fail-closed policy behind an existing channel/plugin seam?
rationale: This PR introduces a new public configuration field and routing precedence across all channels while its stated use case and enforcement are Feishu-specific; repository policy requires maintainer judgment for new config/API surfaces and owner boundaries.

options.title: Approve a generic core selector
options.body: Keep `bindings[].match.conversationId` as a documented cross-channel route primitive, but require a clear provider contract and live Feishu proof before merge.

options.title: Keep Feishu ownership
options.body: Move exact-DM selector semantics and fail-closed enforcement into the Feishu plugin unless maintainers identify a concrete multi-channel core requirement.

options.title: Pause the feature
options.body: Defer the routing surface until a maintainer sponsors the generic API direction and its compatibility contract.

recommendation.title: Keep Feishu ownership
recommendation.body: Move exact-DM selector semantics and fail-closed enforcement into the Feishu plugin unless maintainers identify a concrete multi-channel core requirement.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Feishu routing work makes this contributor the strongest available history-based routing candidate.
